book.grounded.medical.intro:
§lFIELD MEDICINE§r

Every limb has its own health. Lose your head or torso and you die.

Treatment takes time: hold the item. Let go early and it only half works.

Hover an item for exact values.
book.grounded.medical.tips:
§lTIPS§r

Stop the bleeding first, then heal.

Sprinting reopens fresh wounds.

Bandits and survivors carry medicine. Give a survivor a meal and they may trade some.

§8R / U: JEI recipes§r
book.grounded.medical.desc.bandage: Stops light and moderate bleeding. 2 s.
book.grounded.medical.desc.tourniquet: Heavy and critical bleeding. Arms and legs only. 3 s.
book.grounded.medical.desc.pressure_dres: Stops any bleed and binds a fracture. Slow: 7 s.
book.grounded.medical.desc.painkillers: Pain gone for 10 min, kicks in after 45 s. 4 uses.
book.grounded.medical.desc.morphine_inje: Fast, strong painkiller; removes shock. Weakness afterwards.
book.grounded.medical.desc.first_aid_kit: 2 HP per second while held. 30 uses. Stops light bleeding.
book.grounded.medical.desc.bloodbag: Left-click: mode. Extraction draws blood, Transfusion gives it. Match blood types.
book.grounded.medical.desc.regenerative_: Slow regeneration for 90 s. Hunger and concussion risk later.
book.grounded.medical.desc.emergency_sur: Restores a dead limb in 15 s. -30% limb health for 15 min.
book.grounded.medical.received: You received a field medicine book with every medical recipe and what it treats.
